task: survey how the open source http clients in this repository handle request retries

roles.name: retry-policy-surveyor
roles.mission: survey how each http client module in the repository implements request retries and backoff

slices.brief: survey the retry handling in the synchronous client modules under src/sync
survey the retry handling in the asynchronous client modules under src/aio
survey the retry handling in the shared transport helpers under src/transport

acceptance: every client module under src is covered by at least one finding
each finding names the file and line where the retry decision is made
